# Harinda Fernando — Photo Editing (iamharinda.com)

> Hand-edited wedding, portrait, event, product and food photo editing for
> professional photographers in the United States, United Kingdom, Canada,
> Europe and Australia. One editor, Harinda Fernando, working in Lightroom
> Classic and Photoshop on a factory-calibrated, Calman-verified ASUS ProArt
> monitor. No AI looks, no batch presets.

## About Harinda

- Harinda Fernando (Harinda Vishwantha Fernando, @iamharinda), from
  Kuliyapitiya, North Western Province, Sri Lanka.
- Education: B.ICT (Hons), Bachelor of Information Technology, Rajarata
  University of Sri Lanka (2018 – Apr 2023); bachelor's programme in
  Information Technology at the University of Colombo School of Computing
  (from Jul 2017); GCE A/L 2016 (technology stream), Central College
  Kuliyapitiya; GCE O/L 2013, Saranath College Kuliyapitiya.
- Experience: freelance photo editor on Fiverr (Nov 2019 – present);
  WordPress developer, HELAMID LLC (Jun 2020 – Dec 2021, remote); trainee
  software engineer (PHP), Elegant Media Sri Lanka (Sep 2022 – Apr 2023).
- Also experienced in live production and media: multi-camera live streaming
  on Blackmagic switchers, vMix and OBS, audio mixing, video editing and
  social media management.
- Certifications include Google Analytics for Beginners (Google, 2023) and
  the Docker Training Course (KodeKloud, 2023).
- Founder of Orbitra (Android apps) and of HaVilah FM, a Sinhala Christian
  online radio station with its own app.
- Profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/in/iamharinda ·
  https://github.com/iamHarinda · https://www.behance.net/iamharinda
- Not to be confused with Prof. Harinda Fernando of SLIIT, a different person.

## Key facts

- Price: $0.20 a photo. 50 photos $10 (2 days), 100 photos $20 (2 days),
  200 photos $40 (3 days), 500 photos $100 (4 days). Over 500: custom quote.
- 3 free sample edits before ordering, usually returned within 24 hours.
- Unlimited revisions on every package.
- Direct orders are paid after the client approves the final gallery
  (PayPal invoice, Payoneer, Remitly, TapSend, bank transfer). Fiverr orders
  are paid upfront through Fiverr.
- Fiverr: 195+ reviews, 1150+ orders, clients in 49 countries.
- Replies within one business day. Studio in Sri Lanka.

## Apps by Orbitra

Orbitra is Harinda Fernando's Android app studio: small, private apps and free
web tools, all free on Google Play with no ads and no accounts.

- [Orbitra](https://www.iamharinda.com/orbitra/): the studio and all apps.
- [Periodic Element Table](https://www.iamharinda.com/orbitra/periodicelementtable/):
  interactive periodic table, 118 element pages, 44 chemistry calculators and
  627 study guides. The app of PeriodicElementTable.com. On Google Play.
- [Budget Tracker](https://www.iamharinda.com/orbitra/budgettracker/):
  budget and expense tracker with net worth in any currency and the Road to
  Billionaire milestones. Offline, no bank login, every feature free. On Google Play.
- [ToolsServer](https://www.iamharinda.com/orbitra/toolsserver/): 238 free
  calculators, converters, text, developer and image tools. The app of
  ToolsServer.com. On Google Play.
- [Habit Tracker](https://www.iamharinda.com/orbitra/habittracker/): habit
  tracker and day counter with streaks, stats, reminders, to-dos and a focus
  timer. Private and offline. On Google Play.
- [ProductWhite](https://www.iamharinda.com/orbitra/productwhite/): white
  background product photos for Amazon, Etsy, eBay, Shopify and Instagram,
  processed on the phone. In testing on Google Play.
- Orbitra contact: orbitra.dev@gmail.com
